title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary upon the Acts of the Apostles, translated by Christopher Fetherstone, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Acts, chapter 13. In his Commentary upon the Acts of the Apostles, in the Christopher Fetherstone translation, Calvin writes at Acts 13, verse 1: Here followeth an history, not only worthy to be remembered, but also very profitable to be known, how Paul was appointed the teacher of the Gentiles; for his calling was, as it were, a key whereby God opened to us the kingdom of heaven. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 3, chapter 11.
